Name: PIF Art Gallery
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=6]Introducing you to your [u]PERSONAL[/u] Art Gallery!

[/size][size=4]I am sure I am not the only one who has struggled to Find a place for all of my absolutely beautiful art work, both modded and vanilla so what better solution than to have your very own art gallery. Comes in two sizes Starter and Royal.[/size]

[size=4]This mod is a precursor to my Art Gallery map that will be in the decoratable town of Cedarbrook Village.[/size]

[size=5][u][i][b]Compatibility

[/b][/i][/u][/size][size=4][b][u]Multiplayer[/u][/b] - Host and Farmhands will all need to have this mod and its requirements downloaded in order to be able to use and see this mod.

[b][u]Recolors[/u][/b] - This mod only uses the base game tilesheets making it compatible with any recolor that recolors the vanilla tilesheets[/size]
